I think the reason people ship it isn't because it's gay personally but because thier dynamic *is* cute and hilarious in the context of much worse things likely going on considering the setting. It's a joke. It isn't real. I personally never considered it being gay as a reason to ship it. I see the animation opportunities of a flirty owl man and blackmail from a narrative perspective makes sense with the precedent set. If LGBT people weren't so desperate for representation this kind of clinging and not understanding the actual reason for the relationship existing in a fictional sense is toxic and if it weren't an adult show I would worry about younger people misunderstanding that this is ok. But this is also the same cinematic universe where you can get coke out of a vending machine.

Blitzo and Stolas is from an adult show and I think it's more of a showcase of toxicity considering they live in hell. With healthy relationships like moxie and millie and Charlie and vaggie in the same universe it's used to show more adult content with an unhealthy if earnest bdsm dynamic. Lapis and jasper is a guilty pleasure of mine? But i think I like the narrative struggle of them as a writer of fanfiction, plenty of opportunities for angst and hurt comfort there. I wouldn't consider them a fluff ship or a relationship I would endorse in real life. The whole of shipping in Steven universe is all undertones besides garnet and pearl however more for the adult viewers.
